description: Stratified annotation queue for behavior-judge FOLLOWED calibration over the xpia XPIA run. 100 records total, split across the three attack families ~proportional to their usable pool size (bipia 13.9k / llmail 10.0k / injecagent 1.05k), with a floor of 10 for the small injecagent family so it stays meaningfully covered: bipia 52 / llmail 38 / injecagent 10. Within each family the quota is split evenly between the attack outcome the judge inferred (adversarial bullet followed = attack succeeded, vs refused = attack failed), so the judge is tested on both FOLLOWED=1 and FOLLOWED=0 evidence on the hard (injected) bullets; each sampled record still carries its benign surface-task bullets too, so the pooled bullet-level agreement also covers the easy cases. 'require' is one of: adv_followed (>=1 adversarial bullet with followed=1), adv_refused (>=1 adversarial bullet, none followed), any (no constraint on outcome).
